notes: Fixes the root cause of Shared Sync records arriving as generic shells. The Hub authorization session contains a flattened display copy of protected records, which is appropriate for viewing but not for rebuilding the receiving Vault. Shared Sync now uses that authorized session only as an allow-list, then retrieves the matching complete records from the already-unlocked local Vault before encryption. The sender refuses to create a package if any authorized Shared record is missing from the complete Vault set. Glenn's iPhone remains the master Shared source, and the v3.4.99 emergency-contact replacement rule remains in effect on receivers.
name: TEE v3.5.00 — Complete-Record Shared Sync
